name: cdx
description: Ask a current Codex model for a second opinion on a decision or a whole solution design, checked against this repository

interface.shortDescription: Second opinions from Codex on decisions and solution designs
interface.longDescription: One manual-only skill. $cdx:consult asks a current Codex model about a decision before it becomes code, grounded in this repository rather than in the session transcript. It sizes itself to the question: a single decision is answered in the main thread, a whole solution design is delegated to a subagent that owns the consultation threads and returns a validation report. Requires the codex MCP server at user scope; deepwiki is optional. Consultation only — writing code and reviewing written code belong to the Codex CLI plugin. The plugin ships no subagents, so there is no install script to run.
defaultPrompt: Ask Codex for a second opinion on this design
